description: Copy source RGB into an atlas with alpha-only isolation, map a clean bark interior with continuous world-height phase, trace the woody spine beneath its matching photo pixels, and separate static wood from native Wind foliage in a two-block prefab.

Use 240-node wood and 157-node foliage components; adjacent canopy root avoids tall trunk filler cells
Load texture bytes and await image load before editable source export
Check native effect and network packet independently; missing effect becomes packet None
Require fresh phase-specific success report after each server run
advantages: Static trunk with native foliage wind configuration
No helper required in shipped asset pack
Preserves old models and approved grass texture
disadvantages: Original concept crop blur is retained
Alpha cards still need client overdraw and wind review
Two-block prefab must be placed as a complete assembly
Fine branch structure increases total geometry compared with the earlier trial
